'''Bulga the Crude''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. Residing on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]] she also shared her knowledge with others alongside [[Deagan Farrell]].
